component.name: TPMPlaner
component.summary: Today's calendar events and due tasks on your desktop

description.p: A small window that stays out of the way: below every normal window but above the desktop, with no taskbar entry, no window-switcher entry, and no way for it to steal focus. One shortcut brings it forward for a few seconds.

Google Calendar and Tasks, Microsoft Graph (Outlook, Teams and To Do) and any CalDAV server — iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail, Synology, mailbox.org — side by side. Several accounts are queried in parallel, and one failing never blanks the others.

It shows what a list hides: a day rail with one coloured segment per event, a marker for right now, overlapping meetings flagged, and tomorrow's first entries once today is done. Tasks due today or earlier, oldest first, with a few seconds to change your mind after ticking one off.

Interface text in twenty languages, Arabic and Hebrew among them — and dates, times and reading direction come from the operating system, so a 12-hour clock or a right-to-left layout are simply correct.
